desc.zh: 镜山神社的末代巫女，阴阳与式神之术的传人。
desc.en: The last miko of Kagamiyama Shrine, heir to the arts of Onmyo and shikigami.

story.zh: 纱代是镜山神社仅存的巫女。镜山一脉的术法源出古时传入尼朋的震旦阴阳术，又与本地神乐及式神之法相融。内战期间大社遭焚毁，师父临终前将刻有阴阳符与镜山纹的神乐铃交到她手中，此后她便独自守在废社之中。
story.en: Sayo is the last miko of Kagamiyama Shrine. The Onmyo arts came over the sea from Cathay in ages past; in the line of Kagamiyama they were wedded to native Kagura and the way of the shikigami. When the shrine burned down during the Nipponese civil war, her dying master pressed into her hands a kagura bell engraved with the sigil of yin and yang and the crest of Kagamiyama, and she has kept vigil among the ruins ever since.
